name: CarPlay Ultra-Lite
description: CarPlay Ultra features on a Gen5W head unit's own screen, for wireless CarPlay with iOS 26 or later: the car's climate in CarPlay both ways (dock temperatures, Apple's Climate app, a panel per seat with power buttons, Driver Only, seat heat, front and rear defrost), and with the E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing mod's theme on, the CarPlay Ultra theme with its wallpapers and Themes page. DiPO's CarPlay receiver is patched in memory (libCarPlayCore.so, one recipe per library build); the vehicle state streams use ports 7130-7135 on the hotspot (video's side streams 7138-7139). Built and tested on the Ioniq 6 (CEEV USA 260507 and CAN 250818); CEEV CAN 260903 is a port that has not been tried on a car yet; run the compatibility check (cp-climate-check) before installing on another car. Based on LIVI by Lasse Heitgres (GPL-3.0).
